- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to underpredict upward moves; adjust forecast upward by 0.5–1.5% for the next 3–5 days.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.33), model often overpredicts downward moves; adjust downward by 0.5–1.5% for the next 3–5 days.
- Model consistently underestimates price spikes in the 10–15 day horizon; add 1–2% buffer to forecast for spikes > 1.5% from recent high.
- Model overestimates mean reversion in 30-day horizon; reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for 30-day periods with strong recent volatility.
- Model shows lag in reacting to sentiment shifts; if sentiment turns positive after 3–5 days, adjust forecast 1–2 days ahead with +0.5–1.0% slope.
- For 30-day forecasts, model tends to underestimate final price; add 0.5–1.5% to final forecast if sentiment remains positive or volatile in last 5 days.
